title: Touch2Robot: Robot Touch in the Human Demonstration Loop
abstract: arXiv:2609.24660v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable way to collect manipulation data, but their contacts may be unstable or infeasible when transferred to a robot hand. Collecting demonstrations directly on the target robot avoids this mismatch but substantially increases the cost of data collection. To address this trade-off, we present Touch2Robot, a framework that lets humans collect demonstrations while seeing how the target robot hand would contact the object. We capture human hand motion, tactile-glove measurements, and object motion during human manipulation. These recordings guide object-specific RL policies to reproduce the demonstrated object motion while favoring contacts consistent with the recorded human touch. We distill the learned behaviors into a unified real-time retargeter that maps incoming human observations and object geometry to robot hand configurations. translated_title: Touch2Robot：人类演示回路中的机器人触觉
translated_abstract: 人类演示提供了一种可扩展的操作数据收集方式，但当将其迁移到机器人手上时，其接触方式可能不稳定或不可行。直接在目标机器人上收集演示可以避免这种不匹配，但会大幅增加数据收集的成本。为了解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了Touch2Robot，这是一个让人类在收集演示的同时能够看到目标机器人手将如何接触物体的框架。我们在人类操作过程中捕捉人手运动、触觉手套测量数据以及物体运动。这些记录引导针对特定物体的强化学习策略来复现所演示的物体运动，同时优先采用与记录的人类触觉相一致的接触方式。我们将学习到的行为蒸馏到一个统一的实时重定向器中，该重定向器将输入的人类观测数据和物体几何形状映射到机器人手配置。在收集过程中，预测的机器人配置与（原文截断）
tldr: Touch2Robot通过让人类在演示时实时看到机器人手的预测接触方式，结合触觉手套测量、物体特定强化学习策略和蒸馏得到的实时重定向器，解决了人类演示迁移到机器人手时接触不稳定与直接在机器人上收集数据成本过高之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: Touch2Robot addresses the trade-off between unstable contact transfer from human demonstrations and the high cost of collecting demonstrations directly on robots, by letting humans visualize predicted robot hand contacts during demonstrations, using tactile glove measurements, object-specific RL policies, and a unified real-time retargeter distilled from learned behaviors.
